name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor Ainsworth's journey to motorsport security began unconventionally. After serving ten years in the Royal Military Police, specializing in protective security and threat assessment, she transitioned to the private sector, consulting for high-profile clients. A chance encounter at a historic racing event sparked her interest in motorsport. Recognizing the unique security challenges posed by the fast-paced and high-stakes environment, she saw an opportunity to apply her specialized skills. 

Her approach to security is proactive and meticulous, focusing on risk mitigation and preventative measures. Eleanor believes in fostering a culture of security awareness within the team, ensuring that every member understands their role in maintaining a safe environment. Her unflappable demeanor and strategic thinking make her a formidable asset, earning her a reputation as a security professional who leaves no stone unturned.

What sets Eleanor apart is her ability to blend military precision with a deep understanding of the motorsport world. She doesn't just implement security protocols; she tailors them to the specific needs of the team and the unique challenges of each event. This adaptability, combined with her unwavering commitment to safety, makes her an invaluable asset to Tony Kart Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a short, layered bob that frames her face.
physical.description: Eleanor is of medium height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, multi-tool kit.
Insists on a pre-event security briefing, even if it's just a formality.
Has an uncanny ability to spot potential security weaknesses that others miss.
